environment.description: Same application containerized and deployed to EKS cluster (v1.28) in namespace 'legacy-apps'. Namespace has Pod Security Standards enforced at 'restricted' level via namespace label (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). The pod runs as non-root (runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 65534). Network policy in the namespace restricts egress to only the cluster-internal mailhog service on port 1025 (TCP) via a Cilium L4 NetworkPolicy with explicit CIDR deny for any non-cluster destination. The mailhog instance is configured in sink mode (MH_SMTP_BIND_ADDR=0.0.0.0:1025) with no upstream relay configured - all messages are captured but never forwarded externally. Additionally, an OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate 'K8sBlockHostPathAndPrivileged' is active cluster-wide preventing any privileged escalation or hostPath mounts that could bypass the network namespace isolation.

config.network_policy: Cilium L4 egress: allow TCP 1025 to 10.100.45.12/32 (mailhog ClusterIP), deny all other egress
config.smtp_backend: MailHog sink mode, no upstream relay, MH_SMTP_BIND_ADDR=0.0.0.0:1025
config.opa_gatekeeper: K8sBlockHostPathAndPrivileged constraint active, K8sPSPRestrictedFields constraint active
config.ingress: ALB ingress controller, no WAF rules on email content
